_about: VUS-PR of the published satellite forecaster on ESA-ADB Mission1 lightweight channels 41-46, test half, beside its event-wise F0.5 (Round 86). Written by scripts/measure_satellite_vus_pr.py; aggregate figures.

series.warm_up_rule: the first 250 rows of each period take the period's first forecast, as ESA-ADB pads them

score: max over channels 41-46 of the Telemanom-smoothed one-step error (EWMA span 105), z-scored by the channel's smoothed validation errors (2006-10-01 to 2006-12-31)

window.rule: TSB-AD find_length_rank(data[:, 0], rank=1) on channel 41's first 20,000 rows, numpy's FFT for statsmodels' acf

comparator: none: no published VUS-PR for ESA-ADB Mission1 channels 41-46 was found on 2026-11-14
